points.quote: Incomappleux River FSR Road Deactivation Prescription Map Sections 1, 3, and 4
WP 1-11 = N5-037 RB/RNSC Bridge Removal, restore natural stream channel
WP 1-14 = N5-036 RB/RNSC Remove bridge and restore natural stream channel.
WP 1-15A = N5-035 RB/RNSC See Appendix A for deactivation prescription.
WP 1-30 = ISP/IAB Install deactivation sign and sign post. Install lock block wall.

map_readings.label: Incomappleux River FSR Road Deactivation Prescription Map Sections 1, 3, and 4
map_readings.shows: Map title. A table beside it lists Section 1 10431m, Section 3 663m, Section 4 225m. The legend shows an orange line as 'Deactivation Prescription'; the orange line is drawn along the road between WP 1-30 and WP 1-1.

map_readings.label: Road Previously Deactivated
map_readings.shows: Callout on the road beyond the end of the orange deactivation prescription line at WP 1-1, near the label Stephney Creek, marking that stretch as previously deactivated.

map_readings.label: Bridge Previously Removed
map_readings.shows: Callout at a red bridge-removal symbol next to WP 1-1 and WP 1-2, marking a bridge already removed.

map_readings.label: WP 1-1 = POT End of deactivation Branch 1
map_readings.shows: Point of termination symbol marking the end of deactivation on Branch 1, at the end of the orange prescription line near the label Stephney Creek.

map_readings.label: WP 1-11 = N5-037 RB/RNSC Bridge Removal, restore natural stream channel
map_readings.shows: Red bridge-removal symbol on the road, between WP 1-10A and WP 1-11A, near the label Scott Creek.

map_readings.label: WP 1-14 = N5-036 RB/RNSC Remove bridge and restore natural stream channel.
map_readings.shows: Red bridge-removal mark on the road between WP 1-14A and WP 1-14B.

map_readings.label: WP 1-15A = N5-035 RB/RNSC See Appendix A for deactivation prescription.
map_readings.shows: Red bridge-removal symbol on the road at a river channel crossing, between WP 1-15C and WP 1-15B, near where the road labelled WP 4-1 branches off and near the blue point-of-termination triangle.

map_readings.label: WP 4-1 = No works required on this road
map_readings.shows: Point on a short side road branching off near WP 1-15B; the road name printed along it is not legible in the image.

map_readings.label: WP 3-7 = ISP Junction with Branch 1. Install deactivation sign and signpost.
map_readings.shows: Junction of the Section 3 road (WP 3-1 to WP 3-6, cross ditches and water bars) with Branch 1; deactivation sign and signpost to be installed. The Section 3 road name printed along it is not legible in the image.

map_readings.label: WP 1-22B = N5-034 Bridge
map_readings.shows: Red bridge-removal symbol on the road inside a pink private land area, between WP 1-22A and WP 1-22C.

map_readings.label: WP 1-25 = PFM/OS Start of pull back section. Partial pull back required over steepened fill. Out slope road surface.
map_readings.shows: Start of a hatched pull back section along the road beside the label Incomappleux River, continuing past WP 1-29 toward WP 1-30.

map_readings.label: WP 1-29 = N5-125 RB Remove bridge.
map_readings.shows: Red bridge-removal symbol on the road within the hatched pull back section.

map_readings.label: WP 1-30 = ISP/IAB Install deactivation sign and sign post. Install lock block wall.
map_readings.shows: Green install-deactivation-sign symbol at the end of the orange deactivation prescription line opposite WP 1-1, where the deactivation starts.

map_readings.label: November 12, 2024
map_readings.shows: Date printed under the map's coordinate system and datum notes.
